description: Rb₂NaHoF₆ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4/m space group. Rb is bonded to twelve F atoms to form distorted RbF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent RbF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent RbF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent HoF₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Rb-F bond distances ranging from 3.00-3.38 Å. Na is bonded to six F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent HoF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent RbF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.34 Å. Ho is bonded to six F atoms to form HoF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent RbF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. All Ho-F bond lengths are 2.17 Å. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Rb, one Na, and one Ho atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Rb, one Na, and one Ho atom.
